description: This file defines a set of asynchronous command handler functions for a web API router related to fixed income rates. It registers multiple commands, each representing a different financial rate or instrument, with associated documentation, examples, and query handling that returns data via the OBBject class.

methods.name: OBBject ameribor( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Handles the AMERIBOR rate data retrieval based on query parameters.

methods.name: OBBject sonia( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Fetches the SONIA interest rate data based on query parameters.

methods.name: OBBject sofr( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Retrieves the SOFR rate data based on query parameters.

methods.name: OBBject iorb( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Provides Interest on Reserve Balances data.

methods.name: OBBject effr( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Fetches the Effective Federal Funds Rate data.

methods.name: OBBject effr_forecast( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Provides projections for Federal Funds Rate.

methods.name: OBBject estr( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
OBBject ecb( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Gets European Central Bank Interest Rates.

methods.name: OBBject dpcredit( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Provides Discount Window Primary Credit Rate data.

methods.name: OBBject overnight_bank_funding( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Retrieves data on Overnight Bank Funding Rate.
